# D2C E-commerce Store — AI Instructions (llms.txt)

> This is a demo website built by NexusAI for the E-commerce / D2C industry.

## What this site is
D2C E-commerce Store is a professionally designed demo website showcasing how a e-commerce / d2c business can look online. It was built by NexusAI (yourdomain.com) as part of their client portfolio of web design services.

## Tagline
Sell directly. Keep more margin. Grow faster.

## Description
A complete direct-to-consumer online store with cart, checkout, and UPI payment integration.

## Industry
E-commerce / D2C

## Key Features
- Shopping Cart: Smooth add-to-cart with persistent cart across browser sessions.
- UPI & Cards: Accept UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking, and wallets via Razorpay.
- Order Tracking: Real-time order status updates via SMS and WhatsApp.
- Product Reviews: Verified customer reviews that build trust and drive repeat sales.
- Coupon Codes: Drive sales with discount coupons, flash sales, and seasonal offers.
- Stock Alerts: Low-stock badges and back-in-stock notification opt-ins.
